correctness.rationale: At t=mk+r, register rotation sends distinct multiplier sets to distinct original coordinates, giving exactly k−r independent product-sign biases u=a^m and r biases v=a^(m+1) and the finite TV double-binomial sum. With centered time floor k(log k/(2b)+s), b=−log a, phase θ={log k/(2b)+s}, the sum of squared biases tends to e^(−2bs+2bθ)[(1−θ)+θ e^(−2b)], with max bias O(k^(−1/2)). Taylor expansion plus bounded-array CLT yields Gaussian log-likelihood N(−z²/2,z²) and TV=2Φ(z/2)−1. H_b(θ)>1 in interior but H_b(0)=H_b(1)=1, giving distinct subsequential curves; chi-square and Hellinger yield the order-k cutoff window. Independently checked finite exact small-k product laws against explicit transition iteration; finite tests do not certify CLT.
